metadata.description: Definitive 2026 NFL Running Back Micro-Metrics across all 32 franchises (Weeks 1-4 Complete, Week 5 Ready).

running_backs.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
running_backs.notes: NFL Master Intel: 3.85 YAC/att, 75% inside-5 share.

running_backs.name: Derrick Henry
running_backs.notes: NFL Master Intel: 4.45 YAC/att, 75% inside-5 share.

running_backs.name: Kyle Monangai
running_backs.notes: NFL Master Intel: 4.25 YAC/att, 75% inside-5 share.

running_backs.name: Chase Brown
running_backs.notes: 16.3 FP in Week 1. Out-snapped and out-touched Zack Moss in the second half.

running_backs.name: Quinshon Judkins
running_backs.notes: NFL Master Intel: 3.75 YAC/att, 75% inside-5 share.

running_backs.name: Javonte Williams
running_backs.notes: Splits passing snaps with Jaleel McLaughlin; dependent on game script.

running_backs.name: Josh Jacobs
running_backs.notes: Clear lead back for Green Bay with heavy goal-line command.

running_backs.name: Jonathan Taylor
running_backs.notes: High floor workhorse (23.6 FP in shootout). Dominates early downs and red zone.

running_backs.name: Kenneth Walker III
running_backs.notes: NFL Master Intel: 4.12 YAC/att, 75% inside-5 share.

running_backs.name: Omarion Hampton
running_backs.notes: Held to 8.3 FP in Week 1 as Jim Harbaugh rotated three backs in goal line.

running_backs.name: Kyren Williams
running_backs.notes: Maintained high snap rate (79%) despite Rams offensive struggles vs SF front.

running_backs.name: De'Von Achane
running_backs.notes: Highest explosive run rate (24%) and TPRR (0.31) among all running backs.

running_backs.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
running_backs.notes: 12.0 FP in Week 1. Dominates goal-line and short-yardage carries in New England.

running_backs.name: Alvin Kamara
running_backs.notes: High route participation (62%) guarantees 5-7 targets per game in trailing scripts.

running_backs.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
running_backs.notes: Clear lead for Jacksonville, commanding both rushing volume and pass routes.

running_backs.name: Cam Skattebo
running_backs.notes: 14.1 FP in Week 1. Commanded goal line and displayed superior burst over Singletary.

running_backs.name: Najee Harris
running_backs.notes: Early-down thumper. Jaylen Warren handles 3rd downs and 2-minute drill.

running_backs.name: Devin Singletary
running_backs.notes: 11.8 FP in Week 1. Ceding high-value red-zone touches to Cam Skattebo.

running_backs.name: Breece Hall
running_backs.notes: Carried an otherwise stagnant Jets offense (32.7 FP MVP). 62% route rate protects floor.

running_backs.name: Jaylen Warren
running_backs.notes: NFL Master Intel: 4.15 YAC/att, 75% inside-5 share.

running_backs.name: Christian McCaffrey
running_backs.notes: NFL Master Intel: 2.95 YAC/att, 45% inside-5 share.

running_backs.name: Tony Pollard
running_backs.notes: Slight edge over Tyjae Spears in snap share and goal-line looks.

running_backs.name: Tyjae Spears
running_backs.notes: High passing down role, but capped between-the-tackles volume.

running_backs.name: Rachaad White
running_backs.notes: Sub-par 2.65 YAC/att. Losing ground on early downs to Bucky Irving.
